pending.title: Braiins Warns of Hashrate Hijacking Attacks Hitting Over 1,000 Bitcoin Mining Sites
pending.summary: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins has warned that attackers are exploiting unencrypted Stratum V1 connections and internet route hijacking to impersonate mining pools, impacting over 1,000 sites by redirecting computing power and potentially stealing rewards.

posts.title: CFTC Staff Issues Guidance Allowing Exchanges to Count Crypto Toward Operating Reserves
posts.summary: Staff at the U.S. CFTC have issued new advisory guidance stating that regulated derivatives firms and exchanges may count major crypto assets, specifically Bitcoin, Ether, and payment stablecoins, toward meeting operating reserve requirements.

posts.title: South Korea Proposes Ending 2017 ICO Ban to Boost Onshore Crypto Investment
posts.summary: South Korea's Financial Services Commission proposed lifting the country's 2017 initial coin offering ban through a new Digital Asset Act. The rules would allow domestic token issuers to raise capital locally under strict IPO-style disclosure requirements.

posts.title: Utah Moves to Dismiss Criminal Charges Against Kalshi Following Operations Halt
posts.summary: Utah's attorney general office filed motions to dismiss criminal charges against prediction market Kalshi after the firm halted services in the state. However, state authorities cautioned that criminal accusations regarding gambling laws could be refiled if the platform resumes operations, leaving broader legal questions unresolved.
